text:
marta: Heads up — noticed a user who should've been deprovisioned last week still has admin rights in Console. Saw it via an ops ticket. :eyes:
omar: Can you share the username?
marta: alice.g — removed from LDAP on 2026-03-08, SCIM log shows a 200 for user delete but group mapping still shows 'staff:admin' after the event.
owen: Hmm. We rolled the RBAC mapping refactor on 2026-03-05. Possible regression in group sync.
li: I pulled raw SCIM packets — looks like some DELETE events came with an empty "groups" field (omitted vs empty array), our mapper treats omitted as "no-change".
li: example payload snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "alice.g",
  "userName": "alice.g@redwood.ai",
  "active": false
  // note: no "groups" key here
}
```
and our code path only diffs when payload.groups is defined.
sec-oncall: How many users could be affected? Any sensitive scopes?
marta: From the ticket looks like 7 accounts retained admin group membership; 3 of them are in prod-access role.
andrew: If the mapper treats omitted as skip, then LDAP->SCIM clients that remove group attr will never deassign. We should treat omitted as empty meaning "user removed from all groups that were mapped by SCIM".
owen: I'll open an emergency PR to change mapper semantics and add strict schema validation. Will also add a unit test for omitted vs [].
provisioner-bot: deploy-bot: new deploy queued by owen (branch: fix/scim-omit-handling) — CI running.
li: Also a follow-up: our audit logs currently record "user.delete" and the response, but we didn't capture pre-event group membership at time of delete. We should log pre-state to enable forensics.
andrew: Agreed. Add pre-state snapshot to audit log for any delete/provision events. Also run a one-off backfill to reconcile current state vs LDAP source.
marta: How would we run the backfill?
andrew: Command I used before: `infra/provisioner/bin/backfill_groups --since=2026-03-01 --dry-run` then remove --dry-run once vetted.
li: I'll add a migration job: `scim_backfill_pipeline` to run in the maintenance window and emit detailed audit records to S3 and the security index.
owen: For hotfix: revert the refactor behavior to previous semantics first, deploy, then roll in schema + tests. We need to limit blast radius.
sec-oncall: Also let's search for any KMS-encrypted audit bundles that might have missing entries; if we backfilled and produce new audit logs, ensure KMS ACLs are correct so auditors can decrypt.
andrew: Good call. I'll verify KMS key policies and rotation window. No rotation now, but I'll add a note to rotate after incident triage.
marta: ETA for hotfix?
own: PR opened, will push hotfix within 30m, monitoring for deprovision events after deploy.
li: I'll kick off the dry-run backfill overnight and post results in #eng-security tomorrow.
provisioner-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix deploy successful (canary: 2 pods) — 1769456622
sec-oncall: After the canary, any signs of restored group membership removals?
marta: Checked 4 of the 7 users — now correctly removed from admin group. Will validate full set after backfill.
andrew: Once backfill completes, rotate any session tokens for removed users and expire active sessions in Console.
li: Added ticket SEC-2026 for audit log snapshot and KMS policy review.
own: Will follow up with PR link and logs. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
